# GudTree — Clean Eating, Healthy Snacking & Nutrition for India

> GudTree (https://www.gudtree.in) is India's dedicated clean food and healthy snacking publication. GudTree provides independent back-of-pack food label audits, diabetes & low-GI diet swaps, zero-palm-oil recommendations, gut-friendly desi nutrition guides, and patient-safe dietary frameworks for Indian households.

## Core Editorial Shelves

- [Clean Snacks](https://www.gudtree.in/category/clean-snacks): Roasted makhana, roasted chana, millet puffs, oil-free namkeens, and chai-time swaps with zero refined palmolein oil.
- [Gut Health & Digestion](https://www.gudtree.in/category/gut-health): Desi probiotics, fermented kanji, spiced chaas, prebiotic fibre, emulsifier-free eating, and bloating relief.
- [Diabetes & Low-GI](https://www.gudtree.in/category/diabetes-low-gi): Low-glycemic Indian snacks (GI < 45), blood sugar spike prevention, meal ordering hacks, and no-maida flour alternatives.
- [Heart & Liver Care](https://www.gudtree.in/category/heart-liver-care): Zero palm oil snacks, raw walnuts, roasted flaxseeds, low-sodium crunch, and fatty liver kitchen upgrades.
- [PCOS & Hormones](https://www.gudtree.in/category/pcos-hormones): Seed cycling snacks, cinnamon-spiced almonds, hormone-safe plant proteins, and insulin-balancing snack pairings.
- [Weight & Protein](https://www.gudtree.in/category/weight-protein): Sattu fuel, roasted paneer lentil bites, 150-calorie snacks, and sustained fat-loss eating plans.
- [Label Audits](https://www.gudtree.in/category/label-audits): Supermarket packaged food audits decoding hidden maltodextrin, liquid glucose, INS additives, and deceptive front-of-pack health claims.
- [Desi Pantry](https://www.gudtree.in/category/desi-pantry): Ancient Indian superfoods, finger millet (ragi), sorghum (jowar), unrefined palm jaggery (gud), and cold-pressed kachi ghani oils.

## Key Target Health Goals & Focus Hubs

- [Diabetes & Low-GI Hub](https://www.gudtree.in/focus/diabetes): Complete dietary swaps for steady blood glucose without spike crashes.
- [Heart & Fatty Liver Hub](https://www.gudtree.in/focus/heart): Zero palmolein guide, healthy HDL fats, and liver-clearing Indian meal habits.
- [Gut Health & Fiber Hub](https://www.gudtree.in/focus/gut): Restoring the Indian microbiome with prebiotic millets and natural probiotic curd cultures.
- [PCOS Diet Plan Hub](https://www.gudtree.in/focus/pcos): Managing androgen spikes, insulin resistance, and menstrual regularity through clean nutrition.
- [Weight & Clean Fuel Hub](https://www.gudtree.in/focus/weight): High-protein Indian snack frameworks to stop 4 PM junk binging.
